notes: Three independent deliverables that each must be produced correctly in one shot inside a single /app: (1) root-cause and fix a release-mode -O2 crash in a custom C++ boundary-tag heap (the bug is that heap_free never returns blocks to the free list, so a free-then-reallocate request yields NULL and the harness dereferences it); (2) load a native .so and call its exported int64 transform with the exact ctypes signature (POINTER(c_uint8)+c_size_t, restype c_int64) so the buffer is passed by pointer and the 64-bit sum read; (3) reverse-engineer a compiled C target purely by observation/disassembly (3x3 low-pass convolution, divisor 16, replicated edges) and reimplement it so stdout matches byte-for-byte. Every deliverable is executed by the verifier on hidden workloads/files/grids plus malformed/empty edge inputs, with exact integer checksums, FFI return values and transformed bytes, and byte-identical reimplementation output. Rubric total 18 -> hard; >=2 in dependent_stages, tool_breadth, reasoning_depth, debugging_ambiguity, adversarial_inputs, hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness.
